cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a documentary image of adult men in cloths, hats, arm/leg ornaments, and sticks, gathered before clay-walled buildings, consistent with traditional Nigerian dress and daily life claimed for the Berom people; no evidence contradicts the attribution.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, small group of adult male "elders" at "meeting". Wearing cloths, hats, arm-ornaments, leg-ornaments, some holding sticks, one appears to be smoking a pipe. Clay walls at rear.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
